title: Alibaba Cloud KMS provider deprecated — removed in 2.0
quote: It will be removed on the next minor release.
remediation: Migrate the Alibaba stores named to another provider; 1.2 marks the provider Deprecated (warning event and admission warning) and 2.0 removes it.
verifyCommand: kubectl get secretstores.external-secrets.io,clustersecretstores.external-secrets.io -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.provider | has("alibaba")) | "\(.kind) \(.metadata.namespace // "-")/\(.metadata.name)"'  # each row is an Alibaba store
